does: Looks a book up at Wikidata when you ask for its information or a cover: by its title and author. Finds multilingual titles, original titles, series, translators and Wikimedia Commons covers. Nothing changes until you choose.
works: Wikidata (www.wikidata.org, CC0 open catalog) and Wikimedia Commons for covers
changes: Finds books only: films, TV series, operas and characters of the same name are left out, and so are books by another author when you ask with an author
error.too_many: Wikidata found more than it could look through for this book. Try its full title.
